Solar Energy Systems Engineer said about it: As Solar Energy Systems Engineer, the best existing solar-only precedent is the ColdHubs walk-in store described in ColdHubs | Agrinnovators (E2), which is 3 metre by 3 metre by 2 metre for up to 3 tonne with roof Photovoltaic (PV) panels where the panels generate 6 kilowatt and the room uses 1.5 kilowatt to 2 kilowatt, so a roof array about three times the cooling load with battery backup runs 24/7 off-grid and maps directly to the fixed-tilt array (C1) scaled to 1 tonne.
